# bb.haruhime.moe

> Source for https://bb.haruhime.moe, an osu! BBCode editor with a live preview and templates for userpages, tournament forum posts and beatmap descriptions. Anyone signs in with osu! to make templates (BBCode with `{{key}}` fields), share them in a public gallery, fork others' and report bad ones; six built-in templates live in the repo. The editor (CodeMirror 6 on @haruhimemoe/bbcode) keeps named drafts in the browser and writes player lists and mappools from pools.haruhime.moe, `/collab` draws imagemaps, `/docs` documents every tag osu! reads, and the site never hosts images. Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript 7 and MongoDB, run with Bun. MIT license. The live site serves its own llms.txt at https://bb.haruhime.moe/llms.txt; this file covers the repository.

## Site

- [llms.txt on the live site](https://bb.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): notes on osu! BBCode, the pages, the docs, the built-in and public templates and the legal pages
- [llms-full.txt on the live site](https://bb.haruhime.moe/llms-full.txt): the API docs, every guide and legal page, every tag and the common questions in one Markdown file
- [bb.haruhime.moe](https://bb.haruhime.moe/): the live site

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe#readme): what bb does, its features, stack and the shared packages it uses
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions, data rules and file layout for AI coding agents
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, environment variables, tests and the checks a PR must pass
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability (GitHub private vulnerability reporting first, then email)

## Source

- [src/lib/bbcode.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/lib/bbcode.ts): the one seam every preview renders through
- [src/components/editor/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/tree/main/src/components/editor) and [src/lib/codemirror/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/tree/main/src/lib/codemirror): the editor, its toolbar and tools, and the CodeMirror setup
- [src/constants/content.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/constants/content.ts): the content registry every docs, guides and legal page (and the tag pages, as docs extras) is built from
- [src/constants/tag-docs.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/constants/tag-docs.ts) and [content/guides/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/tree/main/content/guides): the docs' words on each tag, and the guides
- [src/utils/template-fill.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/utils/template-fill.ts): filling a template's `{{key}}` fields
- [src/schemas/template.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/schemas/template.ts) and [src/models/Template.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/models/Template.ts): a template's fields, limits and indexes
- [src/services/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/tree/main/src/services): making, changing, listing, reporting and counting templates, deleting accounts, osu! user lookups and pool import
- [src/components/collab/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/tree/main/src/components/collab) and [src/utils/region-geometry.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/utils/region-geometry.ts): the collab maker and its region math
- [content/templates/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/tree/main/content/templates): the built-in templates
- [src/lib/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/tree/main/src/lib) and [src/env.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/env.ts): bb's wiring of @haruhimemoe/next-kit (route helpers, rate limits, env, MongoDB, osu! sign-in and the account store)
- [src/constants/seo.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/constants/seo.ts), [src/utils/docs-seo.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/utils/docs-seo.ts) and [src/utils/template-seo.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/utils/template-seo.ts): titles, descriptions and JSON-LD, built with @haruhimemoe/next-kit/seo
- [.env.example](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe/blob/main/.env.example): every environment variable, with what it's for

## Elsewhere

- [@haruhimemoe/bbcode](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bbcode): parsing, rendering, lint, counting, flags and template fields
- [@haruhimemoe/next-kit](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/next-kit): the Next.js server plumbing packs, pools and bb share
- [@haruhimemoe/ui](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui): the React components and theme the site is built from
- [@haruhimemoe/pool](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pool): the content filter, and buckets, slots and mods for pool import
- [@haruhimemoe/osu](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu): osu! API v2 shapes, links and the client for users, beatmaps and star ratings
- [@haruhimemoe/brand](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/brand): generates the logos, icons and link preview, and draws the template, guide and tag preview cards
- [pools.haruhime.moe](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe): the mappool builder whose public and unlisted pools bb imports
